title: Cloud Canopy: City Stewardship

foundation.history: A forgotten suspended library once protected aerial roots, until recurring severe canopy winds forced residents to abandon it.

premise: Rika Alto, a planner, must repair shared urban infrastructure, relying on district budgeting despite severe canopy winds.
central_conflict: an exclusionary syndicate threatens the suspended library by restricting aerial roots.

plot_beats.name: Discovery
plot_beats.cause: severe canopy winds destroys the primary approach
plot_beats.effect: The player must choose an alternative entry

plot_beats.name: Competing truths
plot_beats.cause: an exclusionary syndicate contests access to aerial roots
plot_beats.effect: The protagonist must reconcile independent testimony

plot_beats.name: Reconstruction
plot_beats.effect: The choice of stewardship rewrites the alliance map

endings.consequence: Locals create an autonomous stewardship cooperative
Survival is proven but structural inequity remains
